items.title: Richer banners
items.text: Banner text now supports headings and headerless tables in its markdown subset, so status overlays can be laid out with more structure.

items.title: Banner colors that fit in
items.text: The banner background now shares the hue of its pane's tint, so it blends with the pane instead of standing out as a mismatched block.

items.title: No more white-flash panes
items.text: Opening the background-color picker no longer flips panes to white while you adjust it.

items.title: Cleaner session re-attach
items.text: When you relaunch and re-attach persistent sessions, panes now repaint correctly (proper SIGWINCH-driven redraw) and scrollback replays with the right width, so re-attached terminals come back looking right instead of smeared.
